source.title: Black Housing Dye: Dragonflight herb recipe
source.author: Tequima (Wowhead comment)

quote: Alchemists and scribes must visit the Housing dye station to create the new Housing Dyes directly from 10 of a herb.
notes: Current patch 12.1+ Dye Crafting, NOT Dragon Isles Milling. The source maps the herb name to this dye; the rank-1 item ID is separately identified on item pages. The source does not separately enumerate rank-2/3 IDs. This is a fixed exchange, not a measured random drop.
where: Dye Station in a housing neighborhood
requirements: Classic Alchemy or Classic Inscription; 12.1.0 or later

source.title: I Bet You're Dyeing to Hear About This
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

quote: housing dye pigments are a thing of the past
notes: Effective in patch 12.1.0 (2026-08-11), corroborated by Warcraft Wiki Dye Crafting patch history. Prior 11.2.7-12.0.x herb -> pigment -> dye path is obsolete; new path is herb -> dye at neighborhood Dye Station. Applies to Dragonflight herbs as well as herbs from other expansions. No drop-rate inference.
affects: Dragonflight herbs used for housing dyes: Writhebark, Bubble Poppy, Hochenblume, Saxifrage; old dye pigments replaced by nine Housing Dye items
wording: Simply take the herbs you want to use to the dye station
